searchText: Well, that's a full server spam Hey everyone, I was wondering if anyone runs. full-node or miner. I have a question regarding the way that you are monitoring the server. I think everyone recommends tracking your validator on beaconcha.in Sorry! Just realized you were talking about miners and not validators. excerpts.content: Hey everyone, I was wondering if anyone runs. full-node or miner. I have a question regarding the way that you are monitoring the server. I run a geth locally and access the metrics at `debug/metrics/prometheus`, but I am unsure what metrics are important and how to organize them in charts. excerpts.author: krustybunkers
excerpts.content: I think there are different schools of thought on the need for monitoring. Some people set up grafana dashboards using prometheus as the datasource for validator metrics. Others don't see the need, go in and just prune geth every once in awhile. I think everyone recommends tracking your validator on beaconcha.in

excerpts.author: krustybunkers
excerpts.content: Sorry! Just realized you were talking about miners and not validators. On that front, i can't really help

excerpts.author: odyslam
excerpts.content: My question actually stems from the fact that during the day I am DevRel at netdata, which is an opensource monitoring agent, and I was wondering whether an integration would make sense. To be more exact, it's more a matter of organizing the metrics into charts that produce value for the user.
